findings.claim: Retired-agent references remain outside the single docs redirect note.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 1.2 requires grep outside the stated exclusions to return only the redirect note, and the change states "Keep a redirect note in docs/agent-team.md"; the packet shows `.agent-team/roles/fhir-architect.md:19` still says "absorbed the former ideation-strategist role" and `.agent-team/roles/fhir-tech-lead.md:19` still says "absorbed the former knowledge-curator role".
findings.suggested_fix: Remove retired-role mentions from role sources and generated harness files; keep the only retired-agent-name redirect in `docs/agent-team.md`.

findings.claim: The committed KBD project config contains a user-specific absolute local path.
findings.evidence: The new `.kbd-orchestrator/project.json` sets `focus_project_path` and workspace folder path to `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/TribeHealth/fhir-server`, while the constraints state all commands run from the repo root.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a repo-relative path, omit machine-local workspace paths from committed config, or replace them with a portable placeholder resolved at runtime.
